top_signals.title: Oil Swings as Traders Assess Iran War De-Escalation Prospects
top_signals.summary: Oil swung as traders weighed diplomatic efforts to de-escalate the Iran war and reach a resolution that could support energy flows from the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed Should Gather Data to Judge Price Risks, Williams Says
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams said, "This is the appropriate time to accumulate more information to help us determine what the appropriate stance of policy is, to make sure we achieve a timely return to our 2% [inflation] target." He made the comments at an event at the European Central Bank in Frankfurt. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Renewed U.S.-Iran tension could push oil past $100: Rapidan Energy
top_signals.summary: Bob McNally predicts that both Brent and West Texas Intermediate futures will jump above $100.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
top_signals.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Traders Wrong-Footed After Bullish Equity Calls
top_signals.summary: Wall Street’s biggest trading desks spent weeks saying the stock-market rally would resume once the election was done. On Thursday, that call backfired spectacularly.

top_signals.title: Brasília em Off
top_signals.summary: Martha Beck fala sobre o vilão que o quarto mandato do presidente Lula quer vencer. Com produção e edição de Rafaela Duarte (Source: Bloomberg)
